plan.title: Forward auction auto-title for two locations

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the event type to Auction while retaining the default auction configuration.
Apply the first available auction template so the product sheet is rendered.

args.goal: On the single-stage forward auction create screen, leave the title field empty and add CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB twice, selecting Plant Name for one row and Gurgaon for the other; stop with both rows visible and the automatic title displayed.

steps.note: The catalog has no direct argument for selecting distinct row locations, so perform this buyer-side interaction on screen.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
